name: Vasino Leto
source:
Vasya Molchanov is a super genius inventor who stuck his nose where it doesn't belong and was forced to hide. When he was found, he had to take off in his car in a hurry, which caused him to get into an accident. Waking up, Vasya noticed that he had been transported into the game Everlasting Summer. Realizing this, he decides to take advantage of such an opportunity properly.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2012268306]Steam[/url]]
translation:
瓦夏·莫尔恰诺夫是一位超级天才发明家，他把鼻子探到了不该做的地方，被迫躲了起来。当他被发现时，他不得不匆忙开车离开，导致他发生了事故。一觉醒来，瓦夏发现自己已经穿越到了《常夏》这款游戏中。意识到这一点，他决定好好利用这个机会。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2012268306]Steam[/url]]
